model_annotation: This image presents three donut charts that illustrate the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021. Each chart comprises four sectors, visually represented by distinct colors: industry, construction, trade, and other services. The number of enterprises chart displays the following sectors: industry, 2.4 million, 8%; construction, 19.0 million, 61%; trade, 5.9 million, 19%; and other services, 3.7 million, 12%. The number of persons employed chart shows: industry, 13.4 million, 9%; construction, 80.2 million, 51%; trade, 29.5 million, 19%; and other services, 33.0 million, 21%. The turnover chart displays: industry, 10.6 trillion, 33%; construction, 1.9 trillion, 6%; trade, 9.9 trillion, 31%; and other services, 9.8 trillion, 31%. Each chart includes a legend that indicates the color coding for each sector. The donut charts do not feature percentage labels within the sectors, but the proportions can be easily determined visually. No sectors are visually distinguished through highlighting or expansion. The sectors appear to be arranged in descending order of size within each chart.
